# v0.3 RefSeq panel provenance

Snapshot date: **2026-09-29**

## Selection

NCBI Nucleotide ESearch was queried for complete RefSeq genomes descending from each genus:

- `Teseptimavirus[Organism] AND "complete genome"[Title] AND srcdb_refseq[PROP]`
- `Teetrevirus[Organism] AND "complete genome"[Title] AND srcdb_refseq[PROP]`

The snapshot returned:

- 12 complete RefSeq records for **Teseptimavirus**;
- 18 complete RefSeq records for **Teetrevirus**.

The v0.3 analysis uses all 12 Teseptimavirus records and 17 Teetrevirus records.

## Anti-redundancy rule

Two active RefSeq records are titled *Enterobacteria phage T3, complete genome*:

- `NC_003298.1` (38,208 bp)
- `NC_047864.1` (38,202 bp)

To avoid giving the same named T3 organism two observations in a genus-level comparison, v0.3 retains `NC_003298.1`, which was already used in v0.2, and excludes `NC_047864.1`.

This is an analysis-design decision, not a claim that the two records are sequence-identical.

## Scope

This panel is a reproducible **RefSeq census snapshot for these two genera**, not a census of every GenBank assembly and not a benchmark for all Studiervirinae.
